warnings: IDENTICAL LEVEL SET TO A-06, WHICH IS THE POINT OF CHECKING IT. Both sheets print the same five levels and the same 2.55/3.10/3.40/0.60 chain closing on +9.65, drawn from two different directions. That is an independent repeat, not a copy of one reading - and it is why A-06's +9.65 is preferred over S-02's +10.00 note (see A-06's own warning).

*** THE y CHAIN HERE IS THE MIRROR OF รูปด้าน 2 AND CLOSES ON THE SAME 8.60: 1.60 + 3.00 + 4.00 under 8.60, then 2.80 + 1.00 eave, with the bubbles running bottom-line first. Read together with รูปด้าน 2 this pins the y grid from both ends: 8.60 between the origin line and the bottom line, and 2.80 from the origin up to the printed prime line. Same mirror-order trap as รูปด้าน 3.

*** DANGLING CALLOUT, RECORDED AND FLAGGED, NOT RESOLVED. *** The elevation carries a leader labelled แบบขยายรูปตัด ค. The set's section callouts are ก and ข (both on A-08) and no sheet anywhere in the 27 pages is titled รูปตัด ค or contains a section so named. This is the §7-checklist item 5 case - a callout that must resolve and does not. It is recorded verbatim with a flag rather than dropped, and rather than being guessed onto A-08.
Door and window marks are not transcribed here.

OPENING VOCABULARY RESOLVED ON A-14/A-15 (หน้า15, หน้า16). This file records no ป/น marks because the glyphs are unreadable at this scan's resolution. The schedules give the full closed list - eight door types ป1-ป8 and nine window types น1-น9, seventeen marks - so any later pass adding positions to this sheet has a fixed vocabulary to match against and cannot invent a mark. What is still missing is only WHICH type sits in WHICH opening on this drawing.
